text: Welcome. To help me understand your condition, could you please describe the nature of your postmenopausal bleeding and any associated symptoms like abdominal pain or weight changes?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any abdominal pressure, pelvic pain, or a feeling of fullness? I also need to know if you have a family history of ovarian or breast cancer.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Intermittent bleeding from the vagina. I also have No recent weight loss, No fever, No changes in bladder or bowel habits.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any known family history of ovarian, breast, or colon cancer, and have you noticed any abdominal distension or bloating? I would also like to examine the adnexal mass further, so REQUEST TEST: Transvaginal Ultrasound.

text: RESULTS: Pelvic Ultrasound: Thickened endometrial stripe and left adnexal mass observed

speaker: Doctor
text: The ultrasound shows a thickened endometrial stripe, which requires further evaluation to rule out malignancy. REQUEST TEST: Endometrial Biopsy.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the endometrial adenocarcinoma and the adnexal mass, I need to rule out ovarian involvement or a synchronous primary tumor. REQUEST TEST: CA-125.

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal CA-125 is reassuring, but the adnexal mass still needs characterization. REQUEST TEST: Pelvic MRI.

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal MRI and CA-125, combined with the biopsy results, suggest the adnexal mass is likely a benign leiomyoma or a separate benign ovarian cyst rather than ovarian cancer. Given the confirmed endometrial adenocarcinoma, we must proceed with staging to determine the extent of the uterine disease. DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Adenocarcinoma
